title: 5 Best AI HR & Payroll Tools for Solopreneurs in 2026: Manage Contractors and Payroll Without an HR Team
description: Compare the 5 best AI HR and payroll tools for solopreneurs in 2026. Gusto vs Deel vs Remote vs Rippling vs Justworks — hire contractors, manage payroll, and stay compliant across 50+ countries without an HR department.
content:
## The HR Nightmare Every Solopreneur Faces Eventually

You start solo. You do everything yourself — sales, product, support, marketing. But eventually, you hit the ceiling. You need help. You hire your first contractor, then a second, then a third. Suddenly, you're a "company" with people relying on you for their paycheck — and you have zero training in payroll tax, employment law, contractor classification, or international compliance.

This is the moment most solopreneurs discover that HR and payroll are a hidden tax on growth. Get something wrong — misclassify a contractor, miss a payroll deadline, or ignore a country's specific employment law — and you could face fines, lawsuits, or worse.

The good news: 2026 has brought a wave of AI-powered HR and payroll tools purpose-built for small teams. These platforms handle the compliance, tax calculations, payment processing, and paperwork — so you don't need an HR department or a $500/hour employment lawyer.

In this guide, we're comparing **5 AI HR and payroll tools** that solopreneurs are using to hire and pay talent across borders without the headache. We'll cover real pricing, compliance capabilities, and exactly which tool fits your specific hiring situation.


## At a Glance: The 5 AI HR & Payroll Tools Compared

| Tool | Best For | Starting Price | Key Capability | Contractor Support | Full-Time Employee Support | Compliance Coverage |
|------|----------|---------------|----------------|-------------------|---------------------------|---------------------|
| **Gusto** | US-based solopreneurs hiring US contractors & employees | $40/month (Simple) | Full US payroll, benefits, compliance | Yes | Yes | US only |
| **Deel** | Global contractor & EOR hiring | $49/month (Contractor) | 150+ countries, EOR in 100+ | Yes (global) | Yes (via EOR) | 150+ countries |
| **Remote** | Global EOR & contractor management | $29/month (Contractor) | 90+ countries, fair pricing | Yes (global) | Yes (via EOR) | 90+ countries |
| **Rippling** | Full HR + IT in one platform | $8/user/month (core) | Device management, app provisioning, global payroll | Yes | Yes | US + 185 countries |
| **Justworks** | US-based solopreneurs needing PEO | $59/employee/month (Basic) | PEO model, health insurance, compliance | No | Yes (via PEO) | US only |


## Gusto: The Best Choice for US-Only Solopreneurs

If you're a US-based solopreneur hiring other US-based contractors or employees, Gusto is the gold standard. It handles payroll, benefits, compliance, and HR administration with an interface that's refreshingly simple.

**What makes it different:** Gusto's AI-driven compliance engine automatically flags potential issues — like misclassified contractors or missed tax filings — before they become problems. It also learns your payroll patterns and suggests optimizations like retirement plan contributions or tax withholding adjustments.

**Standout features:**
- **AutoPayroll:** Set it and forget it — Gusto calculates, deducts, and files payroll taxes automatically
- **AI compliance alerts:** Flags contractor misclassification risks, minimum wage issues, and overtime violations
- **Hiring & onboarding:** Generate offer letters, collect W-4 and I-9 forms, set up direct deposit — all digitally
- **Health benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance through Gusto's broker network
- **Time tracking:** Built-in time tracking for hourly contractors and employees
- **Year-end automation:** Auto-generates W-2s and 1099-NECs, files them with the IRS and SSA

**Pricing:** Simple plan at $40/month + $6/employee/month (contractor or employee) — includes payroll, basic compliance, and contractor payments. Plus plan at $60/month + $9/employee/month adds full HR tools, time tracking, and project management. Premium at custom pricing adds dedicated support and HR advisory.

**Limitations:** US-only. If you need to pay someone in the Philippines or a freelancer in Germany, Gusto can't help. The $6/employee/month can add up if you're contracting with many people on a short-term basis.

**Best for:** US-based solopreneurs who hire US contractors and employees exclusively. Perfect for the first 1–20 team members.


## Deel: The Gold Standard for Global Hiring

Deel has become the dominant platform for international hiring, and for good reason. It handles the entire lifecycle of a global contractor or employee — from compliant contracting and onboarding to payroll, benefits, and offboarding — in over 150 countries.

**What makes it different:** Deel's AI compliance engine tracks employment laws across 150+ countries and updates your contracts automatically when regulations change. If you hire someone in France and France updates its termination notice period, Deel updates your contract templates. You don't even think about it.

**Standout features:**
- **Global contractor management:** Generate locally compliant contracts for 150+ countries in minutes
- **Employer of Record (EOR):** Deel becomes the legal employer for your international hires — handles payroll, taxes, and compliance in 100+ countries
- **AI contract generation:** Input the country, role, and compensation, and Deel generates a fully compliant contract
- **Multi-currency payments:** Pay in 120+ currencies via bank transfer, PayPal, Payoneer, or crypto
- **Equipment management:** Ship laptops and equipment to remote team members, handled by Deel
- **Global benefits:** Health insurance and retirement plans for international employees through Deel's EOR

**Pricing:** Contractor plan at $49/month per contractor (includes compliance, payment processing, and support). EOR plans start at $599/month per full-time employee (includes salary, taxes, and compliance — the employee's actual salary is additional). HR platform at $19/month (entry-level HR tools without contractor management).

**Limitations:** The EOR pricing is significant — $599/month per employee doesn't include their salary. For full-time international employees, budget $599/month + salary. The platform has many features, and some users find the interface overwhelming at first.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who hire contractors or employees in multiple countries. If you have even one international team member, Deel is the safest, most compliant option.


## Remote: Fair Pricing for Global EOR

Remote (remote.com) is Deel's biggest competitor in the global HR space. It offers similar services — contractor management and employer of record — with a focus on transparent, predictable pricing.

**What makes it different:** Remote's pricing is simpler and often cheaper than Deel for certain use cases. Their contractor plan at $29/month is significantly more affordable, and their EOR pricing is published transparently on their website (most competitors require a sales call for EOR pricing).

**Standout features:**
- **Contractor management:** Locally compliant contracts, payments, and expense tracking for contractors in 90+ countries
- **Global EOR:** Hire full-time employees in 90+ countries without setting up local entities
- **AI compliance monitoring:** Automated tracking of local employment law changes
- **Remote Relocation:** Handles visas and relocation for employees who need to move
- **Global benefits:** Health insurance and pension plans through local providers
- **Built-in time off management:** Track PTO and sick leave across countries with local compliance

**Pricing:** Contractor plan at $29/month per contractor ($19/month if billed annually). Global EOR starts at $199/month per employee (plus salary) — significantly cheaper than Deel's $599/month. Also offers a free HR platform for basic employee management.

**Limitations:** Fewer country coverage than Deel (90+ vs 150+). The platform is newer and has fewer integrations. Some users report slower customer support response times compared to Deel.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who need global hiring capabilities but want more affordable EOR pricing than Deel. Great if you're hiring in the 90 countries Remote covers.


## Rippling: HR + IT + Payroll Under One Roof

Rippling is unique because it combines HR and payroll with IT management — device provisioning, app access control, and security. It's built for companies that want one platform to manage both people and the technology they use.

**What makes it different:** When you hire someone in Rippling, it can automatically provision their laptop, create their email account, grant access to all your SaaS tools (Slack, Notion, GitHub, etc.), and add them to your insurance — all from a single trigger. When you offboard someone, it deprovisions everything instantly.

**Standout features:**
- **Unified HR + IT:** Hire someone, and Rippling auto-provisions their devices and app access
- **Global payroll:** Pay employees and contractors in the US and 185+ countries
- **AI payroll assistant:** Automatically flags payroll errors, tax filing issues, and compliance gaps
- **App management:** Control which apps your team can access and enforce security policies
- **Device management:** Ship, configure, and manage company laptops remotely
- **Time and attendance:** Clock in/out from any device with GPS verification

**Pricing:** Core HR starts at $8/user/month plus $35/month base fee. Global payroll and contractor management at $8/user/month. Full platform (HR + IT + Payroll) pricing varies based on features selected. Most solopreneurs end up paying $20–$50/user/month for a comprehensive setup.

**Limitations:** Rippling's modular pricing means the base cost can climb quickly as you add features. The platform is best suited for solopreneurs who have at least 3–5 team members and need IT management alongside HR. It's overkill if you only have one or two contractors.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs with 5–50 team members who want integrated HR, payroll, and IT management. The device provisioning alone is worth it if you send laptops to remote team members.


## Justworks: The PEO Option for US Solopreneurs

Justworks operates as a Professional Employer Organization (PEO) — meaning it co-employs your team members and handles all HR, payroll, benefits, and compliance. It's a different model from the other tools on this list.

**What makes it different:** As a PEO, Justworks becomes the legal employer of record for your US employees. This gives you access to Fortune 500-level health insurance rates, 401(k) plans, and compliance protection that a small business couldn't get on its own. Justworks files all tax forms, manages unemployment insurance, and handles workers' comp.

**Standout features:**
- **PEO model:** Better benefits rates and compliance protection through co-employment
- **Health insurance:** Access to major carriers (Aetna, Cigna, Blue Cross, United Healthcare)
- **Compliance shield:** Justworks handles ACA compliance, COBRA, FMLA, and state-specific regulations
- **Automated payroll:** Tax calculations, filings, and payments handled automatically
- **Time off tracking:** Unlimited and accrued PTO policies managed by the platform
- **AI compliance alerts:** Notifies you of regulatory changes affecting your business

**Pricing:** Basic plan at $59/employee/month includes payroll, tax filings, and compliance. Plus plan at $99/employee/month adds benefits administration and PTO management. Concierge plan at custom pricing includes dedicated HR advisory.

**Limitations:** Contractors only — Justworks does not support contractor payments. This means you need a separate solution (like Deel or Gusto) if you work with independent contractors. US-only — no international capability.

**Best for:** US-based solopreneurs hiring US employees (not contractors) who want the compliance safety net and benefits pricing that a PEO provides.


## Real-World Scenario: Which Tool Should You Pick?

**You're a US solopreneur with 2–3 US contractors →** **Gusto** ($40/month + $6/person). Simple, affordable, handles 1099s and direct deposit perfectly.

**You're a US solopreneur with 1 US employee →** **Gusto** for payroll or **Justworks** ($59/employee/month) if you want health benefits and compliance protection.

**You hire contractors in 3+ countries →** **Deel** ($49/month per contractor) or **Remote** ($29/month per contractor). Deel for more country coverage, Remote for better pricing.

**You're hiring your first international full-time employee →** **Deel** ($599/month EOR) or **Remote** ($199/month EOR). Remote is significantly cheaper, but verify they cover the country you need.

**You have 5+ team members and send them laptops →** **Rippling** ($8–$50/user/month). The device provisioning and automated onboarding/offboarding saves hours per hire.

**You only have US employees (no contractors) →** **Justworks** ($59/employee/month). Best benefits pricing and strongest compliance protection for US workers.


## FAQ: AI HR & Payroll Tools for Solopreneurs

**1. Can I use these tools with just one contractor?**
Yes. All five platforms support single-contractor setups. Gusto and Deel are particularly good for solopreneurs with just one or two contractors. For a single international contractor, Remote's $29/month plan is the cheapest option.

**2. What's the difference between a contractor and an employee?**
Legally, the distinction matters enormously. Contractors control their own hours, use their own equipment, and work for multiple clients. Employees work under your direction, use your tools, and work set hours. Misclassifying an employee as a contractor can result in back taxes, penalties, and lawsuits. All five tools help you classify correctly, but Deel and Remote are best for international classification.

**3. Do I need an EOR to hire internationally?**
If you're hiring a full-time employee in another country, yes — you need either a local entity (which is expensive and time-consuming to set up) or an Employer of Record service that legally employs the person on your behalf. Deel and Remote offer EOR services. If you're hiring international contractors (not employees), you don't need an EOR — just a compliant contract and payment system.

**4. How do taxes work when I hire internationally?**
When you use a platform like Deel or Remote for contractors, the contractor is responsible for their own taxes. You just pay their invoice. For EOR employees, the platform handles local tax withholding, social security, and filings in the employee's country. You pay the EOR a flat fee that includes salary, taxes, and compliance costs.

**5. What happens if I classify someone wrong?**
The consequences can be severe. In the US, the IRS and Department of Labor can assess back taxes, penalties, and interest for misclassified workers. Internationally, the penalties vary by country but can include fines, back pay of benefits, and legal fees. Deel and Remote offer insurance against misclassification claims — worth considering if you're hiring internationally.


## Summary: Pay People Without the Headaches

HR and payroll shouldn't be the bottleneck that stops you from growing your business. The tools in 2026 are sophisticated enough that a solopreneur can hire a global team, pay them correctly, and stay compliant — all without an HR department, an in-house lawyer, or a dedicated finance person.

**Quick-start guide:**

1. **If you're hiring US contractors only →** Start with **Gusto** ($40/month + $6/person)
2. **If you're hiring global contractors →** Use **Remote** ($29/month per contractor) or **Deel** ($49/month per contractor)
3. **If you're hiring your first full-time global employee →** **Remote EOR** ($199/month) is the most affordable compliant option
4. **If you need US employee benefits →** **Justworks** ($59/employee/month) gives you Fortune 500-level insurance rates
5. **If you're managing a growing team of 5+ →** **Rippling** ($8–$50/user/month) integrates everything

The cost of these tools is a fraction of what you'd pay an HR consultant or employment lawyer. And the peace of mind — knowing your payroll is compliant, your contractors are correctly classified, and your international hires are legal — is worth every dollar.

Stop letting HR anxiety limit your growth. Pick a platform, hire your next team member, and get back to building your business.
